disorder-name.detail: Patients with a newly diagnosed glioma in the frontal lobe; histological grades II/III/IV (33/10/2); WHO classification criteria used.
disorder-name.supporting_text: "Forty-five patients with a glioma in the frontal lobe and fifty-one age-matched healthy controls participated in the study."

dataset-of-origin.detail: All subjects prospectively enrolled and scanned at Beijing Tiantan Hospital, Capital Medical University, Beijing, China. No publicly named dataset.
dataset-of-origin.supporting_text: "All patients were prospectively enrolled between May 2019 and July 2020, and all healthy controls were recruited from the local community and universities." "All subjects were scanned with a Philips Ingenia 3.0 T MRI scanner at Beijing Tiantan Hospital."
dataset-of-origin.location: Zhang2022.pdf.md: Methods / Subjects; Methods / Structural MRI acquisition
